title: Distance Squared
prompt: Given `struct Point { int x; int y; };` in scope, implement `int dist_sq(struct Point a, struct Point b)` returning the squared distance between them.

tests.name: axis aligned
tests.code:
struct Point a = {0, 0}, b = {3, 4};
CHECK_EQ(dist_sq(a, b), 25);

tests.name: negatives
tests.code:
struct Point a = {-1, -1}, b = {2, 3};
CHECK_EQ(dist_sq(a, b), 25);
